restricted_paths: live camera hardware validation or capture
acceptance_criteria: Add an app-level HMI stream builder that converts no-camera replay results into the existing inspection snapshot payload contract.
Add an ASGI WebSocket endpoint for /ws/inspection that accepts a client, sends one replay-backed inspection snapshot, and closes cleanly.
Snapshot payload includes product, phase, decision, reason codes, measurements, observations, and created timestamp.
Current draft product specs and synthetic calibration still produce fail-closed BLOCKED evidence.
Existing WebSocket inspection snapshot contract remains compatible.
No HMI UI, live camera, raw media, model weights, production deploy, secrets, or production authority are introduced.
Existing Flange QC v2 unit/contract tests, product CI, and full repository tests pass.
rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-010 PR to remove the HMI stream builder, WebSocket endpoint change, tests, and evidence artifacts. This task does not alter production data, migrations, secrets, or deploy configuration.
